name: The Meaning Of Marriage
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divinely instituted union between a man and a woman, designed to provide companionship and reflect God's creative order. From the beginning, God recognized that it was not good for man to be alone and created woman as a suitable helper, one who is bone of his bones and flesh of his flesh. This union is marked by a man leaving his parents and cleaving to his wife, becoming one flesh. Jesus affirms this original design, emphasizing the male and female distinction established at creation, while Leviticus underscores the sanctity of this union by forbidding sexual relations outside this God-ordained framework.
